task_summary: Researched Claude Code skills system online, created test skill files (.claude/skills/) in the Claudia project, and verified skills work through the SAP AI Core proxy
mistakes: Initially tried to create a task via test-cli but encountered message format issues - could have just tested the skill directly first
Started the server unnecessarily when it may have already been running or could have been tested differently

learnings.trigger: When testing Claude Code skills/slash commands
learnings.insight: Skills are just markdown files in .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md - they work through any proxy since they're instructions loaded into context, not API-dependent features

learnings.trigger: When creating custom Claude Code skills
learnings.insight: Skills directory structure: .claude/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter (name, description) and markdown instructions. Supports $ARGUMENTS for dynamic input

learnings.trigger: When the Claudia server isn't running
learnings.insight: Use ./start.sh to start the server, but check CLAUDE.md first - it warns against restarting while tasks are running to avoid OOM crashes

task_summary: Implemented WSL support for Claude Code sessions on Windows — toggle in Settings, wsl.exe spawn in backend, config persisted to disk
mistakes: Made changes one-at-a-time across many 'continue' prompts instead of batching all edits in a single message
Generated empty 'no response requested' messages several times with no useful output
Initial spawn used 'wsl' without '.exe' — node-pty on Windows requires the .exe extension, caught and fixed in same session

learnings.trigger: Adding a new boolean config field to Claudia
learnings.insight: Must update 6 places in config-store.ts: AppConfig interface, DEFAULT_CONFIG, loadConfig (loaded branch), loadConfig (fallback return), updateConfig(), resetToDefaults(). Also add getter/setter. Also add to validation.ts ConfigUpdatePayload interface AND booleanFields array.

learnings.trigger: Adding a settings toggle to SettingsMenu.tsx
learnings.insight: Pattern: useState → setFoo(config.foo || false) in loadConfig useEffect → standalone async saveFoo(value) fetch function → JSX toggle in a CollapsiblePanel. No shared helper exists — each boolean has its own save function, consistent with existing code.

learnings.trigger: Spawning processes via node-pty on Windows
learnings.insight: node-pty on Windows requires the .exe extension to find executables (claude.exe not claude, wsl.exe not wsl). Pattern already established at top of claude-code-backend.ts with claudeExe constant.

learnings.trigger: Duplicated platform checks or spawn logic in claude-code-backend.ts
learnings.insight: Extract to private methods: shouldUseWsl() for the detection, resolveClaudeSpawn() for exe/args resolution. Avoids repeating process.platform check and config reads across createTask, reconnectTask, checkInstalled.
